newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair upgrades Singapore cargo service.
newsitem.headline: Swissair upgrades Singapore cargo service.

text.p: Swiss Cargo, the cargo arm of Swissair, said it will upgrade its full-freighter service between Geneva and Singapore with the introduction of summer schedules at the end of the month.
"Frequencies on the service, which was launched in autumn 1996, are to be increased to three from two a week as a result of growing demand," a Swiss Cargo official told Reuters.
The full routeing of the service, operated by a 65-tonne capacity McDonnell Douglas DC-10-30F aircraft, reads: Geneva-Dubai-Singapore-Madras-Dubai-Geneva.
The DC-10F is wet-leased from Gemini Air Cargo.
Swiss Cargo has also transferred the departure airport to Basle from Geneva for its weekly DC-10F service to Sao Paulo, the official said.
Swiss Cargo also operates scheduled freighter services from Basle to Chicago and Seoul.
